claims.quote: Only if counter collection is chosen: after completing registration, present the fictional registration reference at the fictional counter to collect the demo pack.
Only if locker collection is chosen: after completing registration, use the fictional registration reference at the fictional locker to collect the demo pack.

Register a fictional collection request and obtain its fictional registration reference. Registration and collection both have a fictional fee of LKR 0. After registration, choose exactly one collection method: counter or locker. Use the registration reference with the chosen method. Do not perform both alternatives.

Both actions belong to one alternative collection choice, not two visits.
